name: tbhb-rules-storybook-toolchain
description: The npm tools behind @tbhb_rules_storybook//:defs.bzl, linked into each build's and check's tree after the consumer's packages. The renderer libraries (react and react-dom, lit, astro) are the consumer's own dependencies, not pinned here. vitest, @vitest/* and typescript match tbhb_rules_typescript's pins; playwright matches tbhb_rules_playwright's PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION; vite meets astro 7's range.
